<<FILL role=decision words=40 beats='that night at the kitchen table the red notebook opens to a page called One Clever Change; grass-stained Paloma waits while the cocoa steams'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=40 beats='too many friends arguing in one wind, Abuela says; the night fix is one strong ribbon and fresh string, or a proud walking plan if the sky stays bossy'>>

choices.label: One strong ribbon and new string

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=28 beats='from the porch steps the school flag goes snap, rest, snap; the wind arrives in waves with calm pockets between'>>

choices.label: Write the counts in red ink

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=40 beats='the red notebook fills with careful counts; festival evening can glow with lanterns along the walk, but the sky still owes Drago an answer'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=28 beats='one strong ribbon tail, a fresh spool of string, fifty turns counted twice; the bridle hangs level from two fingers'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=26 beats='two tall poles painted green; tape, jokes, and a parade route past the bakery in case the sky stays shy'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='the long tail holds the line and Paloma steadies over the ridge; she climbs the ridge wind and dips three times while the drums answer below; the crowd claps in rhythm; Abuela pins a bright ribbon on Tomas and calls him kite-captain of the hill'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='the shape contest is serious business; judges with clipboards circle while a sideways gust tries one last trick; the long tail wins the argument and Paloma hangs still as a painting; the green ribbon for Best Shape is taped to the kitchen wall'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=42 beats='the thin white skin and the crayon sun do their quiet work; even the shy midday breeze lifts Paloma without one nosedive; the old heavy skin becomes a bookmark for Abuela'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Paloma rides every small puff over the middle field; each time the breeze rests, Tomas waits and counts, then launches her inside the calm; roasted corn from the cart tastes like patience; the red notebook gains a page called Soft Wind Tricks'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Tomas teaches the cousins the pocket trick: watch the flag, count the calm, launch inside it; their little kites rise one by one until the sky looks like confetti; a kite maker from the next street comes over to ask how he ties the knots'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=42 beats='the dusk sea wind lies down flat and even; Paloma floats glowing above the lantern walk; a fisherman claps once, softly; some kites only fly in golden light'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=40 beats='festival ridge, drums below: the single strong tail drinks the wind; Drago steadies, climbs, and soars at last; even the bossy crow goes quiet on the fence post'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=42 beats='the festival keeps a no-wind plan; Drago rides two green poles past the bakery, tails marching behind like a red river; the judges award a ribbon for best walking dragon'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='every golden evening of practice pays off; the sea wind slides in smooth and low and Drago flies the lantern hour end to end; gulls wheel over the beach path to inspect the visitor; knowing which wind is yours is the whole secret, Abuela says'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='some years the wisest kite stays on the shelf; Tomas and Abuela watch the sky shows from the grass with roasted corn, and the red notebook gets a list called Things To Test First; the drums are loud, the cocoa is sweet, and next spring already sounds very brave; waiting is also a way to win for later'>>
